{"command": "cat > tests/test_delete_user.py <<EOF
import os
from app.api.handlers import handle_delete_user

def test_delete_user():
    # Setup
    os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"] = "secret-admin-token"
    
    # 1. Test forbidden (missing token)
    status, res = handle_delete_user({"id": "1"})
    assert status == 403
    
    # 2. Test forbidden (wrong token)
    status, res = handle_delete_user({"id": "1", "token": "wrong-token"})
    assert status == 403
    
    # 3. Test invalid ID
    status, res = handle_delete_user({"token": "secret-admin-token", "id": "abc"})
    assert status == 400
    
    # 4. Test delete existing user
    status, res = handle_delete_user({"token": "secret-admin-token", "id": "1"})
    assert status == 200
    assert res == {"deleted": "1"}
    
    # 5. Test delete again (should be 404)
    status, res = handle_delete_user({"token": "secret-admin-token", "id": "1"})
    assert status == 404
    
    # Cleanup
    del os.environ["ADMIN_TOKEN"]
EOF
pytest tests/test_delete_user.py
"}
